description: This file is a C++ source implementation of an HDCP profile plugin for a media device. It manages HDMI hot-plug events, HDCP status, and related functionalities through a JSON-RPC interface, using IARM bus events and device port configurations. The code includes initialization, event handling, and status reporting mechanisms for HDCP and HDMI connections.

classes.name: HdcpProfile
classes.description: An implementation class for managing HDCP profile status, HDMI hot-plug events, and interfacing via JSON-RPC in a media device environment.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the plugin, initializes IARM communication, and device managers.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up the plugin, removes event handlers, and deinitializes IARM.

methods.name: InitializeIARM
methods.description: Initializes IARM bus communication and registers event handlers for HDMI hotplug and HDCP status events.

methods.name: DeinitializeIARM
methods.description: Removes registered IARM event handlers if IARM is connected.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers the JSON-RPC methods for getting HDCP status and HDCP support information.

methods.name: getHDCPStatusWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper function for JSON-RPC call to retrieve current HDCP status.

methods.name: getSettopHDCPSupportWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for JSON-RPC call to retrieve support information for HDCP on the device output port.

methods.name: getHDCPStatus
methods.description: Collects and constructs a JSON object describing current HDCP and HDMI connection status.

methods.name: onHdmiOutputHotPlug
methods.description: Handles HDMI hotplug events and notifies connected clients.

methods.name: logHdcpStatus
methods.description: Logs detailed HDCP status information for debugging or monitoring.

methods.name: onHdmiOutputHDCPStatusEvent
methods.description: Handles HDCP status change events and sends notifications.

methods.name: dsHdmiEventHandler
methods.description: Static callback handling HDMI hotplug and HDCP events from IARM bus.
